title: 第十九章 凝气散成第二十章 武技小成
content_zh:
从天黑一直练到第二天蒙蒙亮。
“轰！
轰！
轰！”
不知出了多少次拳，却没有什么疲惫感，四肢百骸中的力量更为充沛，猛然的，叶枫听到体内传来一声闷响，经脉中的血液浓郁到了极点，几乎无法再容纳更多了，而在内劲的不断挤压下，通过心脏跳动牵引，血液终于凝练。
第一滴精血，诞生了！
精血诞生，意味着一只脚跨入了换血境。
叶枫心头安定不少，他平心静气，继续控制着内劲挤压躯体各部，让转化出来的精血变得更多。
随着精血数量增加，躯体当中全部桎梏破碎，一切禁锢和瓶颈都被摧枯拉朽般碾碎，他终于达到了换血境界！
轰……
内劲犹如洪荒猛兽般涌入丹田气海，原本拳头大小的丹田，变成了足有尺许方圆。
“砰砰砰砰……”
叶枫继续修炼拳法，一方面用来积蓄内劲，一方面淬炼肉身。
时间推移，他的境界逐渐稳固下来，肉身强横了不止一倍，力量更是接近一千五百斤，此时此刻，面对黄阶下品妖兽火焰虎，叶枫自觉完全有单挑的能力，哪怕遇到五重“化气境”
武者，他也有击败对手的信心。
终于停止出拳，束手而立的叶枫心中升腾起满满自信，整个赵家庄，庄主赵大鹏不出手，又有谁还能奈何自己？
赵天乐，你的死期很快就要到了。
武士七重，步步艰辛。
一旦踏入第四重换血境，就算已脱离低阶武士的范畴，成为真正的武者。
犹如鲤鱼跃龙门般的飞跃。

达到这一过程，要么长久积累，要么，则是服用某些珍贵丹药，除了赵大鹏父子和执事赵天乐，整个赵家庄没有第四人还有这样的能力。
像修武多年的赵火赵七等，处在虎力阶段数年甚至数十年，仍不得寸进。
但叶枫却顺利达到了这一境界。
仅仅在觉醒武脉十多天后，他就迈出了这一步。
如此修炼速度，在整个元武大陆都是绝无仅有的异数。
而一切的一切，都是通过体内唯一这条武脉“万古长青脉”
做到的，到了此时，叶枫才明白“元灵”
替自己开辟出的这条武脉，拥有多么逆天而强大的能力。
而且元灵曾说过，只要获得能量，自己可以再度进入神秘空间。
只是，能量是何物？
该去哪里寻觅？
再度进去后，自己又会得到何种好处？
一个个疑团让叶枫陷入了沉思，他的身躯如一株青松，高耸入云、巍峨不动……
……
赵家大院中。
赵天乐瞪着布满血丝的双眼，神色紧张。
熬炼工作已接近尾声，一大锅水煮干了，院子里到处散发着淡淡的药味，一打开密不透风的锅盖，就能看到，此刻锅底已凝结出一层薄薄的胶状物。
这就是整锅灵药所有的精华了。
小心翼翼将胶状物分成三份收好，赵天乐这才长吁一口气，神色恭敬的进入少爷闭关的那个房间。
“庄主，少爷，幸不辱命，一共熬制出三份凝气散。”

他恭敬说道。
content_en:
Practice from dark until dawn the next day.
"Boom!
Boom!
Boom! "
I don’t know how many times I punched, but I didn’t feel any fatigue. The strength in my limbs was even more abundant. Suddenly, Ye Feng heard a muffled sound coming from his body. The blood in his meridians was so rich that it could hardly hold any more. Under the continuous squeezing of the internal energy and the pulling of the heartbeat, the blood finally condensed.
The first drop of blood essence was born!
The birth of blood essence means that one foot has entered the realm of blood exchange.
Ye Feng felt much more at ease. He calmly continued to control his internal energy to squeeze various parts of his body, so that more essence and blood could be transformed.
As the amount of essence and blood increased, all the shackles in his body were broken, and all the restrictions and bottlenecks were crushed to pieces. He finally reached the stage of blood exchange!
Boom...
The inner energy poured into the Dantian Qi sea like a wild beast, and the Dantian, which was originally the size of a fist, became a foot-wide circle.
"Bang bang bang bang..."
Ye Feng continued to practice boxing, which was used to accumulate internal energy and temper his physical body.
As time went by, his realm gradually stabilized. His physical body was more than doubled, and his strength was close to 1,500 kilograms. At this moment, facing the yellow-level low-grade monster Flame Tiger, Ye Feng felt that he had the ability to fight in a duel, even if he encountered the fifth-level "Qi Transformation Realm"
A warrior, he also has the confidence to defeat his opponents.
Ye Feng, who finally stopped punching and stood with his hands tied, was filled with confidence. In the entire Zhaojiazhuang, if Zhao Dapeng, the owner of the village, didn't take action, who could do anything to him?
Zhao Tianle, your death is coming soon.
The seventh level of warrior, every step is difficult.
Once you enter the fourth level of blood exchange, you will be out of the category of low-level warriors and become a true warrior.
Just like a carp leaping over a dragon's gate.
Achieving this process requires either long-term accumulation or taking certain precious elixirs. Except for Zhao Dapeng and his son and deacon Zhao Tianle, there is no other person in the entire Zhaojiazhuang who has such ability.
For example, Zhao Huo and Zhao Qi, who have practiced martial arts for many years, have been in the tiger power stage for several years or even decades, and still cannot make any progress.
But Ye Feng successfully reached this state.
He took this step just over ten days after awakening his martial veins.
Such a cultivation speed is unique in the entire Yuanwu Continent.
And everything is through the only martial vein in the body, the "Eternal Vein"
It was only at this moment that Ye Feng understood the meaning of "Yuan Ling"
This martial vein that he created for himself possesses such incredible and powerful abilities.
Moreover, Yuan Ling once said that as long as he obtains energy, he can enter the mysterious space again.
But, what is energy?
Where to look for it?
What kind of benefits will you get if you go in again?
Each mystery made Ye Feng fall into deep thought. His body was like a green pine, towering into the clouds and motionless...
…
In the Zhao family compound.
Zhao Tianle stared with bloodshot eyes, looking nervous.
The refining work is coming to an end. A large pot of water has been boiled dry, and there is a faint smell of medicine everywhere in the yard. As soon as the lid of the airtight pot is opened, you can see that a thin layer of gel has condensed on the bottom of the pot.
This is the essence of the whole pot of elixir.
After carefully dividing the gel into three parts and putting them away, Zhao Tianle took a deep breath and respectfully entered the room where the young master was retreating.
"Manager, young master, fortunately, I have lived up to my command and brewed three portions of Qi Ning Powder."
He said respectfully.
